title: Head-to-head returns match list, not an aggregated W/L/D record
evidence: soccer.go:198 & server.go:46 — search_matches accepts an `opponent` filter that returns the head-to-head fixtures, but no tool aggregates them into W/L/D; grep for head-to-head/h2h/headToHead finds nothing. Stats() (soccer.go:222) takes no opponent.
